test_title: PYST 25: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 2 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'CATHOLIC' is written as '79', 'AUDIENCE' is written as '70', how will 'ASSEMBLY' be written in that language?
solution: According to the English alphabets and their positional values: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2279b560b10991887192eff3a548e57e9b0820d787d416555b032b86f014a220.png] The pattern followed in the given codes is: The sum of all alphabets plus the number of alphabets is equal to the code.
